chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
No structure in Islam is more beloved to Allah, Exalted is He, than marriage.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam narrating this report
key_terms.أَحَبُّ: more beloved; especially dear in rank before Allah
key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.ٱلتَّزْوِيجِ: marriage; the act and institution of joining spouses
key_terms.ٱلْإِسْلَامِ: Islam, the religion within which this institution is established

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the virtue of marriage in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that marriage is the most beloved social institution established in Islam. It highlights the great value and sanctity of marriage in building a faithful and stable Muslim life.
